content.introduction: The crypto market saw more than $200 million liquidations today ahead of the Fed's decision on interest rates, with Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana prices experiencing volatility depending on the Fed's sentiments on inflation. Bitcoin was down 2.11% to $82,881, Ethereum dropped 2.22% to $2,651, and Solana fell 4.45% to $118. The market is up today because traders have already priced in the Fed's decision to leave interest rates unchanged.

Crypto Market Today: $200M Derisk Ahead of FOMC, What’s Next for Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana Price?

Highlights

 The crypto market saw more than $200 million liquidations today ahead of the Fed's decision on interest rates.
 Jerome Powell will give his last FOMC speech today as he exits his position in May.
 Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana prices could record volatility depending on the Fed's sentiments on inflation.

The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting is also happening today. But with so much happening, how will Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), and Solana (SOL) react?



1. Why is the crypto market up today?

The crypto market is up today because traders have already priced in the Fed's decision to leave interest rates unchanged.
